text: 770 Don Mills Road is an important City-owned property located steps from the Crosstown light rail transit's new Don Valley Station and the Ontario Line. It has great potential to deliver both housing and community amenities on what is currently a surface parking lot. CreateTO has been in the early stages of developing plans for a transit-oriented and mixed-income development at this site including an elementary school, park space, retail and childcare, along with market and affordable housing. With this mix of uses, the project requires significant collaboration with stakeholders to deliver these outcomes. With the Crosstown light rail transit now open, and the Ontario Line under construction, now is the time to accelerate plans for this site.
